chunks: (that) he would conquer Constantine, Rome and China.
ai.seo_question: Which cities and regions will the Mahdi conquer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Kitab al-Ghayba highlights the universal scope of Imam al-Mahdi’s (a.s.) political and spiritual authority by predicting the conquest of Constantinople, Rome, and China, reflecting the transition from regional to global dominion. In Shia eschatology, these victories symbolize the establishment of justice across the known world, fulfilling the promise that the earth will be filled with equity as it was filled with injustice. The inclusion of China alongside the traditional Islamic centers of power underscores the comprehensive nature of his caliphate.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: he would conquer Constantine, Rome and China.
